maddeler.e:
ننحني (form VII)
# نَنْحَنِي (nanḥanī) /nan.ħa.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
# نَنْحَنِيَ (nanḥaniya) /nan.ħa.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَنَى (inḥanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
